profiles.adopted_edition: Springer Nature Version of Record complete publisher HTML, 2024-02-29
profiles.edition_sha256_unavailable_reason: No raw publisher HTML/PDF byte capture exists at PR #438 baseline; official complete VoR HTML was inspected directly.
profiles.source_scope: Publisher VoR HTML central model, variants and appendices; no raw transport-byte freeze and no exhaustive correction registry.

operator_source_descriptions.ATT-01:history-saliency-priority-integra: Feature saliency, learned selection-history, task weights and previous-trial feature-dimension modulation combine into the integrated priority map (Eq.3).
operator_source_descriptions.ATT-01:priority-to-exgaussian-readout: Priority-map values parameterize the ex-Gaussian response-time distribution (Eq.4) under joint fitting loss (Eq.5).
operator_source_descriptions.ATT-01:variant-evidence-selection: Seven source-defined variants/ablations are compared using Laplace model evidence (Eq.8); the full model retains saliency, intertrial and learned-history contributions.

direct_model_ancestor_notes: No DOI-qualified direct model ancestor is asserted; absence of a Makwana citation is explicitly not used as independence evidence.
adverse_source_limits: Raw publisher byte SHA256 unavailable.
Complete correction-history absence not established.
Whole ancestry remains non-exhaustive.

profiles.adopted_edition: PLOS Computational Biology publisher Version of Record PDF/complete HTML, 2016-02-18
profiles.source_scope: Publisher VoR main model Eqs.1-9 plus source-visible S1 parameter-sensitivity evidence; no exhaustive correction registry.

operator_source_descriptions.ATT-02:two-level-feedback-normalization: Bottom and top visual layers apply local untuned divisive normalization (Eqs.2-3 and 5-6) while exchanging feedforward/modulatory signals.
operator_source_descriptions.ATT-02:top-down-attention-field: Spatial or feature attention multiplicatively modulates higher-area activity (Eqs.7-8).
operator_source_descriptions.ATT-02:modulatory-backprojection: Higher-area activity sends modulatory feedback proportional to feedforward weights (Eq.9), redistributing top-down modulation to lower layers.

direct_model_ancestor_notes: Reynolds & Heeger 2009 (ATT-03) is directly cited as the normalization model; W1 treats this as a shared normalization constituent/theory comparison, not as proved full-model direct descent.
adverse_source_limits: Instantaneous activations omit fine temporal dynamics, synchrony/noise correlations and late-phase effects.
Surround suppression is omitted and the origin of top-down control is unspecified.
S1 sensitivity shows many modeled effects are fragile to +20% parameter perturbations.

profiles.adopted_edition: PLOS Computational Biology publisher Version of Record PDF/complete HTML, 2019-04-09
profiles.source_scope: Publisher main VoR establishes the central hierarchical/flat operators and key adverse controls; S1 File is explicitly required by main text for variant/comparator details but its raw bytes are not frozen at PR #438 baseline and W1 fetch was blocked after publisher redirect.

operator_source_descriptions.BLF-02:coupled-change-point-posterior: A hierarchical learner tracks two transition probabilities and a shared higher-level change-point probability p_c.
operator_source_descriptions.BLF-02:cross-variable-confidence-reset: Evidence for a global change in one transition resets confidence for both coupled transition probabilities, including the unobserved one.
operator_source_descriptions.BLF-02:flat-leaky-beta-count: The flat comparator maintains beta-posterior counts with exponential forgetting (Methods Eqs.2-4), approximating delta-rule estimates without global change-point transfer.

direct_model_ancestor_notes: BLF-03 (Glaze et al. 2015) is directly cited in discussion of leaky integration/adaptive learning; the main source does not establish that the BLF-02 coupled-transition hierarchy is a direct mathematical descendant.

source_loci: BLF-02 main model source_loci and bounded_native_findings

additional_edition_bundle.sha256_unavailable_reason: PLOS S1 File redirect resolved to a time-limited storage object that W1 could not fetch; no raw supplement SHA exists in PR #438 baseline.

adverse_source_limits: S1 File raw bytes/hash remain missing, so full alternative-model/adverse-detail qualification is source-blocked.
Flat and hierarchical first-order estimates can correlate strongly.
Task structure is instructed and only moderately identifiable from one subject's observations.

profiles.adopted_edition: eLife Version of Record, 2015-09-28; publisher v2 PDF receipt
profiles.source_scope: Publisher VoR discrete/continuous normative model, key approximations and version history; accepted-manuscript 2015-08-31 kept distinct.

operator_source_descriptions.BLF-03:hazard-conditioned-logodds-update: Posterior log odds update by adding current LLR to a nonlinear hazard-conditioned transform of prior belief (Eqs.1-2).
operator_source_descriptions.BLF-03:adaptive-leak-boundary: Expected instability produces belief-dependent leak near uncertainty and a hazard-dependent non-absorbing stabilizing boundary at stronger belief (Eq.3 approximations).
operator_source_descriptions.BLF-03:continuous-switching-limit: A continuous-time switching formulation parallels the discrete hazard process and yields time-dependent leaky/bounded accumulation.

direct_model_ancestor_notes: Earlier dynamic Bayesian learning and sequential-sampling models are cited, but W1 does not collapse broad Bayesian/HMM background into one unique direct model ancestor.
adverse_source_limits: Subjects learn hazard rates imperfectly.
Suboptimal leaky-only and bounded-only approximations explain restricted regimes.
Accepted Manuscript and Version of Record are distinct editions.

profiles.adopted_edition: Nature Human Behaviour Version of Record complete open-access HTML, published online 2023-10-16
profiles.edition_sha256_unavailable_reason: PR #438 baseline records publisher PDF browser access but no raw publisher PDF/HTML SHA256; exact VoR HTML was inspected without fabricating a byte hash.
profiles.source_scope: Publisher VoR central adaptor-grammar/library model and variants; explicit adapted ancestor is bibliographically identified but lacks a DOI in the source reference.

operator_source_descriptions.CNC-01:dynamic-concept-library: A latent concept library contains primitives and cached program ensembles whose contents change as learning proceeds.
operator_source_descriptions.CNC-01:pitman-yor-cache-reuse: Gibbs/Pitman-Yor sampling caches favored programs/subparts and reuses them as primitives; Methods Eq.1 controls new construction versus reuse.
operator_source_descriptions.CNC-01:resource-bounded-composition: Search/composition is explicitly resource-bounded rather than exact enumeration over the infinite concept posterior.
operator_source_descriptions.CNC-01:agr-bidirectional-reprocessing: AGR mixes forward and backward phase predictions with a fitted mixture parameter, alongside RR and subsymbolic comparators.

direct_model_ancestor_notes: The source explicitly states that the algorithm adapts Liang, Jordan & Klein (ICML 2010), 'Learning programs: a hierarchical Bayesian approach'; the cited proceedings reference contains no DOI, so no DOI string is invented.
adverse_source_limits: Explicit adapted ancestor cannot be frozen as a DOI-valued direct_model_ancestors entry from the source bibliography.
Deterministic likelihood poorly handles vague concepts.
No conditional primitive, so some reported strategies are inexpressible.
Raw publisher byte SHA256 unavailable.

profiles.adopted_edition: PLOS Computational Biology publisher Version of Record PDF/complete HTML, 2024-04-25
profiles.source_scope: Publisher VoR RNN/LR/MLP architecture and RNN-variant/constraint-regime model space; supplementary figures used only as supporting variant evidence.

operator_source_descriptions.CNC-02:task-trained-recurrent-ti: Continuous-time tanh RNN dynamics with recurrent state, item pulses and linear choice readout are optimized for delay transitive inference.
operator_source_descriptions.CNC-02:connectivity-trainability-variant: f-RNN, r-RNN and ff-RNN variants isolate whether recurrent and/or feedforward weights are trainable.
operator_source_descriptions.CNC-02:constraint-regime-sweep: Five regimes jointly vary initial connection scale and regularization to expose multiple trained neural solutions.
operator_source_descriptions.CNC-02:feedforward-ti-comparators: Logistic regression and single-hidden-layer MLP models test transitive generalization without recurrent working-memory dynamics.

direct_model_ancestor_notes: No source-supported direct descent from C-HORSE/CNC-03 or another selected MAIN model is asserted.

source_loci: CNC-02 RNN variants and constraint regimes

adverse_source_limits: Some networks memorize all training relations but fail transitive generalization.
Multiple neural implementations remain viable; further neural data are required to distinguish them.
Network optimization is not claimed to be the brain's literal learning algorithm.

profiles.adopted_edition: eLife Version of Record, 2023-12-11; publisher v1 PDF receipt
profiles.source_scope: Publisher VoR C-HORSE architecture, pathway roles, autoencoder training and explicit lineage; no claim that inherited architecture is independent-from-scratch.

operator_source_descriptions.CNC-03:tsp-rapid-pattern-separation: Sparse highly plastic EC→DG→CA3→CA1 pathway supports rapid binding, pattern separation and exemplar-specific memory.
operator_source_descriptions.CNC-03:msp-slow-distributed-regularity: EC→CA1 monosynaptic pathway uses more overlapping representations and a slower learning rate to extract category regularities and generalize.
operator_source_descriptions.CNC-03:dual-pathway-autoencoding: The intact network combines both pathways while reconstructing presented features; pathway lesions separate categorization/generalization from exemplar recognition.

direct_model_ancestor_notes: Schapiro et al. 2017b is explicitly identified as prior C-HORSE development. The broader lineage also names Ketz et al. 2013 (DOI 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1003067), but W1 records that as a shared lineage ancestor rather than promoting every lineage citation to an immediate direct ancestor.

source_loci: CNC-03 C-HORSE architecture and pathway roles

adverse_source_limits: C-HORSE is an inherited model lineage, not an independent-from-scratch architecture.
The current model isolates hippocampal contributions and omits interactions with basal ganglia, prefrontal cortex and other cortex.
Whole ancestry remains non-exhaustive.
